recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. If the functionality is still desired, follow up in HL7/fhir-ig-publisher#396 rather than changing FHIR core source.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive with Modification Jira asked for realm-specific IG tooling quality checks, such as warning US-realm IG authors when a Patient profile is not derived from QICorePatient and allowing a documented suppression.
initial_application: No FHIR core source application was found. The Jira resolution created HL7/fhir-ig-publisher#396 for the missing hierarchy access and the Jira comment explicitly marked the issue applied because no further FHIR-side work remained, only publisher tooling changes.
additional_context: FHIR-I IG Authoring minutes from 2022-02-15 approved the publisher issue and recorded FHIR-25783 as Persuasive with Modification. HL7/fhir-ig-publisher#396 remains an open external enhancement to expose profile derivation hierarchy during pre-publish processing. Current core source searches found no active artifact for the Jira key, the publisher issue URL, or the requested QICorePatient/realm quality-check behavior.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No FHIR core source was changed because the decided implementation target is the external IG Publisher repository, not this specification checkout or build.
